entries.name: Super Saiyan
entries.content: Super saiyan, a mixture between Caulifla's Super Saiyan form and Kale's Legendary Super Saiyan form, gaining a slight increase in muscle mass and noticeable increase definition while growing noticeably taller, almost as tall as Goku. Her hair sticks out while turning bright green, and and also still remains in a ponytail. In the manga however, she doesn't have a ponytail, due to already being in the form. Her eyes also become bright green and, uniquely for a Saiyan in a transformed state, her eyes become wider.

entries.name: Super Saiyan 2
entries.content: Super saiyan 2: once again appearing as a hybrid between Caulifla Super Saiyan 2 and Kale's Legendary Super Saiyan 2 forms, with her hair slightly spikier and a lightining aura surrounding her.

entries.name: Grade two
entries.content:
{{Implied Forms: These forms are inbetween the super saiyan 1 and 2 forms: 
[[Super Saiyan Second Grade: in this form, every nerve is concentrated, sending ki through the body to inflate the muscles, raising both power and speed. It is a forced increase in the power output of the initial transformation of super saiyan and thus is not in itself an actual transformation. The hair gets spikier and stands on end slightly more, not as much as third grade or super saiyan 2. Females mantain their femenine figures despite the increased muscle mass.

entries.name: Grade Three
entries.content: Super saiyan Grade Three: All natural inhibitions of the body are completely removed in this state, resulting in 100% utilization of strength and stamina reserves, muscle size is increased to the point of impracticality. The Saiyan's hair grows bigger, spikier and spreads in different directions. The aura no longer flows upward, but flails outward, with surges of bioelectricity becoming more frequent and prominent. When females uses this form, the form is slightly less bulky than male Saiyans, though they still have a heavily muscular feminine physique with an hourglass figure and pronounced abs, traits which would presumably apply to other female Saiyans, like Kefla in this case, in their Super Saiyan Third Grade form. Though females have slightly less bulk than a male Saiyan in this form, her muscles still have enough mass that it impairs her movements showing that female Saiyans can still be affected by the excess weight of their muscles despite having slightly less bulk.

entries.name: Potential
entries.content:
By virtue of being a saiyan, Kefla has the possibilty, with enough training, under special circumstances, or both, to achieve branching or greater forms of super saiyan beyond super saiyan 2, like super saiyan 3 or god.

Also, Kefla's own brand of super saiyan will always keep it's distinct green yellowish hair and teal eyes, save in the cases of Super Saiyan 4, god, blue, blue evolution, or Rosé.

entries.name: Super Saiyan 3
entries.content: Super saiyan 3: The transformation causes some stark changes in physical appearance. The trademark characteristic of the transformation is the user's hair: the rigid hair of the Super Saiyan 2 state becomes flowing and smooth again and grows down to the user's waist. The hair color of Super Saiyan 3 is still golden blonde but takes on a darker and more yellow shade of gold compared to the previous Super Saiyan forms, with a lightining aura more pronounced. A small increase in muscle mass from Super Saiyan 2 is evident, and muscle tone is sharply defined. The eyebrows vanish completely, making the forehead and eye ridges appear larger and revealing a more prominent brow ridge.

entries.name: Great Ape
entries.content:
[[Geat Ape: Although saiyans from universe 6, like Kale and Caulifla, have long lost their saiyan tails due to evolution, saiyans who posses a tail can transform into a great ape by looking at a full moon, increasing their power 10 times at the cost of losing reason. The transformation causes the Saiyan to grow to several times their original size, the color for the Great Ape's fur is usually brown and eyes are red as well. A Saiyan loses the ability to reason in this form, and will typically display berserk and destructive characteristics. Universe 6 saiyans evolved past the need for tails, and it's unknown wether they can access this transformation. User's with enough experience can control themselves while in this form, with some even being able to retain ther human form while still harnessing it's power.]]

[[Golden Great Ape: This state is attained by Saiyans who have a tail, along with the ability to become a Super Saiyan. A saiyan who turned into a Great Ape while also having unlocked super saiyan, as a result, if they turn into a great ape, they will do so with the super saiyan on top of it, resulting in the Golden Great Ape transformation. Their fur is golden-colored and stands on end, similar to a Super Saiyan's spiky hair, but the user's appearance is identical to that of a regular Great Ape regardless. Saiyans who regain control while in this state will revert back to their human forms, but as a super saiyan 4.]]

entries.name: Super Saiyan 4
entries.content:
[[Super saiyan 4: For a Saiyan to attain Super Saiyan 4, they must be able to transform into a Golden Great Ape (the Super Saiyan version of a Great Ape), and subsequently regain conscious control over their form. In this form, the Saiyan's hair color differs, usually the same color they would have in their base form, the tail and the body is covered in red fur. A Saiyan in this form also possesses a shadow trim around their eyes and over the eyelids that varies in color, such as crimson. The hair is lengthened while becoming wilder, reaching down to the middle of their back, while two long pointed bangs of hair appear on both sides of the neck. It also makes the individual considerably larger in height and muscularity. While using this form, the user's upper body clothing will burst open to expose their chest, except if the user is female, in which case only their outermost layer of clothing will disappear.]]

[[Super Full Power Saiyan 4: For the user to achieve this state, they must accumulate a massive amount of Saiya Power to transcend the limits of an ordinary Super Saiyan 4. The form boosts the user's power to astonishing levels and greatly enhances the senses. When a Super Saiyan 4 attains their Full Power, their appearance does not change, but the transcended state is symbolized by a red glow radiating from their entire body, as well as a slight hazy effect surrounding them, as if extreme heat were emanating from them.]] 

[[Super Full Power Saiyan 4 Limit Breaker: In this form, the Super Saiyan 4's body is filled to the brim with ki. The normally reddish fur takes on a magenta hue, and the hair turns crimson red with dark shadows. The user gains a flowing purple aura similar to that of Perfected Ultra Instinct, and a skin-tight white aura when the primary aura is dissipated.]]

entries.name: Super Saiyan God
entries.content: Super Saiyan God: is a Saiyan transformation that grants the user godly ki, providing them with a power boost beyond Super Saiyan 3 and its predecessors. It is initially obtained through a ritual involving six righteous Saiyans or special divine training, though with enough exposure to divine ki, the user can adopt it. In this form, the user possesses magenta-red hair (identical to his fur as a Super Saiyan 4) or crimson red hair. The hair retains its natural style but becomes more refined (losing any stray hairs). The Saiyan's eyes become more detailed, and the irises become red (appearing as more relaxed even in battle until sufficiently angered). The overall body structure appears to become younger and thinner in frame and build. The aura of the Super Saiyan God resembles a raging fire. Trained users can further combine this form with the first Super Saiyan transformation, attaining the more powerful Super Saiyan Blue or Super Saiyan Rosé form (depending on the user's status and ki.)

entries.name: Super Saiyan Blue
entries.content: Super Saiyan Blue or Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan. Transcended version of Super Saiyan God. A transformation that consists in the user using the Super Saiyan transformation while in the Super Saiyan God state. This form is nearly identical to the first original Super Saiyan form, the only main differences being that the hair and irises are now cyanish in color (albeit the irises change to a slightly darker color than the hair) and the aura is a fiery light blue.

entries.name: Super Saiyan Blue Evolution
entries.content: Super Saiyan Blue Evolution: Extremely powerful transformation and an empowered variant of Super Saiyan Blue. Being a form that pushes beyond the normal Super Saiyan Blue, this form looks quite similar to its predecessor. the hair and eyes take on a darker coloring of royal blue as well as the hair growing bigger and spiking outwards like Super Saiyan Second Grade. The eyes also sport visible black pupils, and the aura takes on a similar coloring with a larger and denser nature to it, including light particles that display a stronger glint, similar to Ultra Instinct Sign, taking the form of four-pointed stars and a few occasionally bursting like fireworks; also, the subtle yellow glow of Super Saiyan Blue disappears completely. The user's body gains a noticeable increase in muscle mass and definition, also similar to Super Saiyan Second Grade.

entries.name: Super Saiyan Rosé
entries.content: If the saiyan is an actual deity, instead of transforming into Super Saiyan Blue, they'll instead transform into Super Saiyan Rosé. Identical to the Super Saiyan Blue form in all but color, hair takes on a pastel pink color with faint white highlights, with eyebrows matching the color of the hair, eyes change into a light gray color. The aura's shape is very similar to that of Super Saiyan Blue's with major color differences; it has a very dark shade of red on the outside, while it has a more pinkish color on the inside; while the aura is present. The user will also gain black shadow trim around the eyes. The main difference in this form is the better usage and control of ki and lower stamina consumption.
